findings.title: Technology spend baseline is not sufficiently transparent
findings.description: The current cost view may not provide a reliable enterprise picture for challenge, allocation or investment decisions.

findings.title: Technology cost allocation is not sufficiently actionable
findings.description: Spend may be visible in aggregate but not consistently attributable to services, products, owners or outcomes.

findings.title: Low-value technology spend is not consistently challenged
findings.description: Governance may lack a repeatable mechanism to challenge or stop spend that no longer creates sufficient value.

findings.title: Technology investment benefits are not consistently measured
findings.description: Benefits may be tracked unevenly, reducing the CIO’s ability to distinguish investment that creates value from investment that simply consumes budget.

findings.title: Cloud consumption may contain avoidable leakage
findings.description: Cloud consumption appears insufficiently aligned to actual demand, creating potential optimization and cost-avoidance opportunity subject to evidence validation.

findings.title: Cloud commercial commitments may not be optimized
findings.description: Commitment and commercial structures may leave avoidable cost or flexibility leakage subject to evidence validation.

findings.title: SaaS usage and licensing may contain avoidable overlap or shelfware
findings.description: Subscriptions may not be fully aligned to active users, usage and business need.

findings.title: Software licensing may be inefficient
findings.description: License models, entitlement position or renewal practices may create avoidable cost or compliance exposure.

findings.title: Infrastructure capacity or assets may be underutilized
findings.description: Capacity and lifecycle practices may create avoidable run cost or excess footprint.

findings.title: Technology workforce capacity may not align to demand
findings.description: Skills, capacity or sourcing may be mismatched with actual demand, creating productivity and cost leakage.

findings.title: Vendor economics may contain commercial leakage
findings.description: Vendor structures, commercials or governance may limit leverage and value realization.

findings.title: Complexity and technical debt are contributing to run cost
findings.description: Architecture choices or accumulated debt may be increasing operational effort, change cost or platform cost.

findings.title: Application portfolio may contain avoidable cost
findings.description: Duplication, legacy, low-value or high-support applications may consume disproportionate cost.

findings.title: Business perception of technology value is weak or mixed
findings.description: Stakeholder perception suggests value delivered may not consistently justify technology cost.

findings.title: Technology investment is difficult to redirect
findings.description: Committed run cost, contracts or funding structures may constrain reallocation when priorities change.

findings.title: Manual technology operations may create productivity leakage
findings.description: Recurring work may depend on manual effort that could potentially be automated or standardized.

findings.title: Business-led technology spend is not fully governed
findings.description: Material spend outside the central technology organization may reduce visibility, leverage and enterprise optimization.

findings.title: Transformation spend lacks measurable outcomes
findings.description: Major transformation investment may not have sufficiently clear outcome baselines, targets or post-delivery accountability.

findings.title: AI investment economics are not sufficiently defined
findings.description: AI investment may be proceeding without a consistent view of cost, value, benefits and scale economics.

findings.title: Technology duplication after M&A may dilute synergy
findings.description: Acquired and incumbent technology estates may have overlapping platforms, contracts or teams.

recommendations.title: Establish an Enterprise Technology Spend Baseline
recommendations.description: Create a reconciled view of technology spend across major categories, ownership and material business-led spend.

recommendations.title: Launch Cost & Value Governance
recommendations.description: Create repeatable decision rights and challenge mechanisms linking technology spend to value, risk and strategic priorities.

recommendations.title: Run a Cloud Economics Diagnostic
recommendations.description: Validate demand alignment, rightsizing, commitment strategy, tagging and consumption governance before sizing any savings opportunity.

recommendations.title: Run SaaS & Licensing Rationalization
recommendations.description: Validate utilization, entitlements, overlap, contract terms and renewal timing across SaaS and major software vendors.

recommendations.title: Optimize Infrastructure Footprint
recommendations.description: Validate capacity, utilization, lifecycle and facility/network economics to identify optimization and avoidance opportunities.

recommendations.title: Optimize Workforce & Operations
recommendations.description: Align demand, skills, sourcing and automation to improve productivity and reduce avoidable run effort.

recommendations.title: Reset Vendor Strategy
recommendations.description: Review strategic vendors, commercial structures, sourcing mix and performance governance to improve leverage and outcomes.

recommendations.title: Rationalize Application & Technology Portfolio
recommendations.description: Prioritize applications and platforms using cost, business value, risk and complexity to simplify the estate.

recommendations.title: Institutionalize Benefits Realization
recommendations.description: Set measurable benefit baselines, targets and post-implementation reviews for major technology investments.

recommendations.title: Build a 12–24 Month Investment Roadmap
recommendations.description: Sequence cost, productivity and reinvestment actions around business priorities, dependencies and organizational realities.
